master.prompt:
Create exactly ONE square image (1024x1024).

Style: clean flat cel-shaded 2D game art for a moody side-scrolling industrial prison action game, painted for pixel conversion: lineless shapes with NO outline and no line art, every material in at most 3 flat tones (highlight, base, shadow), cool purple-leaning shadows and warm highlights, large crisp angular light and shadow shapes, a bold readable silhouette, no gradients, no airbrush, no texture noise, no dithering, no pixel grid. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no border, no frame, no grid.

Reference image: the attached image is an approved in-game sprite from the same game (an in-game factory lineup; copy only materials and grouped shading; ignore figures, composition, labels, and pixel grid): match its flat cel-shaded style, outline weight, shading, figure size and position on the canvas; do NOT copy that character's face, hair, outfit, equipment or colours.

Subject: a complete industrial welding drone for a side-scrolling game, right-facing orthographic side profile with shallow depth so both top rotors can be seen, clearly FACING RIGHT: its front lens and idle torch turn toward the RIGHT edge of the image; forward is RIGHT and its back is toward the LEFT edge. A small squat industrial welding drone, a machine with no humanoid anatomy. One compact asymmetrical rounded angular rusted burnt-orange sheet-steel body, 110:90 width-to-height including equipment, a single large round cyan Haze lens on a knuckled front-right plate clearly looking screen right, two top-mounted distinct dark propeller rotors on short spaced mounts (both visible; far one slightly high and dark), and exactly one jointed thick steel welding torch arm below, bent forward-right at idle with a stubby copper nozzle. Graphite lower plating, three large cooling marks or rust patches only, steel-gray rotors; bold silhouette and minimal chunky details. No legs, no wheels, no humanoid face, no gun, no through-body rotor, no decals, no lettering.

Size and position: one single figure, the top of the figure (including hair, headgear, raised weapons and effects) about 35 percent below the top edge of the canvas and its lowest point about 15 percent above the bottom edge (the figure about 50 percent of the canvas height), the body a little left of centre so there is extra empty room on the RIGHT side for forward motion, generous empty magenta margin on every side, nothing touching or crossing the edges. The whole figure is drawn with solid, fully opaque pixels: no transparency, no semi-transparent glow, no soft aura, nothing blended with the background.

Keep the entire machine centered with margins of 12% or more on all sides, two plainly separate rotors wide apart, not overlapping the eye. The single torch is a short mechanical arm, no fire or effects. Flat angular polygons and hard planes; no fake pixel grid, rough texture, reflections, gradients, shadow on the floor, or drawings outside the object.

Background: solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere outside the character, no shadow, no ground, no glow on the background.
